findings: This is a new bodyweight chest-dip source derived from the approved weighted chest-dip motion, not a newly generated entire athlete or an upright triceps dip. Missing anatomy behind belt/chain/plate was newly authored in each actual pose.

Three genuine poses are reused asA,B,B,C,B,A. Beat2 and3 show the same intermediate at physical progress.5; use t0,.5,.5,1,.5,0 rather than claiming an unshown early.22 pose. Existing initiation/mid-descent/press-up cues remain qualitatively checkable.

The source chest has inherited fine striation/contour lines and mild specular tone variation; those have not been erased. Primary and secondary are remapped to the exact established hues with inherited light/shade.

A few seam-adjacent lower torso/thigh contour differences from native occlusion reconstruction may remain, but native review shows coherent pelvis-to-knee/shin chains, no detached surfaces, no shorts and no visible residual accessories.
The bottom whole-image32px framing registration is measured from three equipment ROIs and applied uniformly before selecting source pixels; no limb/body alignment or source resampling occurs.
Full880x1088 framing preserves the entire station and all three athletes without per-pose scaling.
Native source/card/mobile validation does not assert strict anatomical or mechanical certification.
